text:
emily: Quick PR to add a small availability banner on /regions saying which endpoints support preferred routing and KMS-managed keys. Want wording check before I send to l10n.

rafael: Avoid the phrase "data residency" in public copy; use "routing preference" and call out contractual residency options. Also suggest a one-line KMS caveat: KMS is available in selected regions only.

hui: Spanish page had a broken anchor to the endpoints table. I'll fix it and add a translator note to keep header names verbatim (`x-redwood-region`).

legal: Approve the routing preference phrasing. Please add: "Setting a region header expresses a routing preference; guaranteed data residency is available only under specific contractual agreements."

translations-bot: Preview: https://docs-preview.example.com/branch/region-banner (build 1467).

emily: Thanks all — PR ready: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/4451; will merge after preview and legal ack.
